$description: Hand-authored gradient layer fill colours — used as stops in animated ambient gradients and diagonal blend pairs. Every entry is a DTCG color. Hex-origin entries are emitted in sRGB space; oklch-origin entries stay in oklch.

animated-1.$description: Primary gradient layer — slow 25s ease-in-out infinite shift.

animated-2.$description: Secondary gradient layer — reverse shift, mix-blend-mode overlay.

teal-purple.$description: Teal-to-purple gradient midpoint for button primary.

cyan-green.$description: Diagonal blend A — cyan top-left → green bottom-right.

green-blend.$description: Diagonal blend B — green pairs with cyan.

magenta-pink.$description: Diagonal blend A — magenta top-left → hot pink bottom-right.

hotpink-blend.$description: Diagonal blend B — hot pink pairs with magenta.

coral-blue.$description: Diagonal blend A — coral top-left → blue bottom-right.

blue-blend.$description: Diagonal blend B — blue pairs with coral.

salmon-gold.$description: Diagonal blend A — salmon top-left → gold bottom-right.

gold-blend.$description: Diagonal blend B — gold pairs with salmon.
